stem:
During the morning assembly at a school in Pune, Ravi feels dizzy and has a headache, although he was fine the day before. His teacher says he seems unwell.

Why is Ravi considered unwell?

options.text: His signs show that his body is not working as it normally should.
He was completely healthy the previous day.
His discomfort is not severe, so he can keep attending classes.
Only a serious disease can make a person unwell.

teacher.key_rationale: Being unwell means something in the body or mind is not working as it should; dizziness and headache are signs of this, so A is correct. B does not explain unwellness, C wrongly dismisses mild symptoms, and D wrongly restricts unwellness to severe disease.
